ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Greetings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Greetings.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

9. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)

14. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
